        5        thank you, Senator Farley.

        6                      You not only opened up the

       13        to say to you thank you publicly on behalf of

       15        because of your work it was easy to support this

       16        legislation because it's good for New York State

       18        message that both sides of the aisle can work

       19        well together and I'm really proud of that and

       20        that's because of your leadership, and I wanted

       21        to say that up front.  So thank you, sir.

       23        legislation is important to both the state

       24        banking industry and to the financial consumers

                                                            3275

        1        but it includes all of the constituents of New

        2        York State, all of the consumers.

        3                      This bill will encourage state

        4        banks like Chase Manhattan to remain chartered
in

        5        New York and it's something that Senator Farley

        6        and I have discussed for two or three years.  We

        7        need banks to stay chartered.  This means that

        8        they are more likely to keep their head offices

        9        in the state providing jobs to our citizens.  It

       10        means that these banks will remain subject to
New

       11        York's ATM Safety Act, our basic banking account

       12        requirements and our strong CRA retirements,

       13        Community Reinvestment Act.

       14                      It also means that the financial

       15        consumer will continue to benefit from the
strong

       16        supervision of our state Banking Department

       17        instead of a distant regulator in Washington,
and

       18        again, Senator Farley, this is something you and

       19        I have discussed.

       20                      This bill will make it easier for

       21        banks to sell insurance or invest in the

       22        securities market, something they can do now on
a

       23        limited basis.

       24                      This bill permits our state banks

       25        to exercise the same powers that national banks







                                                            3276

        1        like Citibank now have.  It will keep our banks

        2        strong and competitive in the financial industry

        3        for the next millennium.

        4                      I urge my colleagues to support

        5        it, to support this bill, to support Senator

        6        Farley, to support myself and thank you very

        7        much.
